sign.text: SEED RAIN. An acorn falls 600 m at most. The islet is 2 km out. Who carries an oak across the sea?

dialogue.line: The Great Oak gave one seed. Plant it here and you only copy what we have. Carry it.
Jays bury thousands of acorns and forget half. Feed them and they fly far.
Load what the wind will not bring: willow cuttings, pine cones. The acorns ride with the jays.
Light the beacon when four kinds of green stand on the islet, and one of them an oak.
Bare rock, pioneers, scrub, pine, oak. It starts again. That is succession.

islet.note: Islet is data only for now (2 km east of Island_Pythagoras); colonise() decides arrivals. Placed in Unreal only if the referee allows a second sublevel.

fail_hint: Wind alone brought grass and pine but no oak. Try the jays.
